title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned read-only access from today's documented permissions. Its paths and role-group command are supported, and it appropriately leaves automatic access and role-specific licensing unresolved.
